results.title: “AI, or SI, pardon me” will give you better healthcare than Elon Musk gets, says Elon Musk
results.description: Elon Musk has told reporters at the White House that AI and humanoid robots will most likely make everyone better off. He spoke on Tuesday outside the West Wing, beside President Donald Trump, after the president’s lunch with tech leaders. He began by praising “the positive benefits of AI, or SI, pardon me”, correcting himself […] This story continues at The Next Web
